StepRoundPatch.description:
Patch preview projected from the round's stored bundle.

The durable shape carries ``files[]`` plus ``note``/``diff``/``intent``/
``report``, and single-file rounds also keep the legacy ``file``/``lines``
keys. This read model is built from :func:`stored_bundle` instead of
validating the raw dictionary, so a later writer field cannot break step 6
again.

``diff`` is the candidate commit's unified diff, already split into lines.
New rounds persist it; historical rounds that lack it get a change-block
diff synthesized from the applied ``intent``/``report`` pair, and ``None``
means no diff can be produced, so the client must show the neutral
whole-file preview instead of classifying lines.

post.description:
Upsert one reported bad case as the workspace resolved from URL and credential.

Authentication is a workspace ingest credential
(`Authorization: Bearer whk_…`), not the browser access token. The body may
never carry workspace identity: the workspace comes from the URL, and the
credential must belong to it. A new `badCaseId` answers `201`; re-reporting
an id already owned by this workspace replaces its upstream fields and
answers `200` without consuming quota.

200.description: The same workspace already owned badCaseId; upstream fields were replaced

X-HE-Workspace-Used.description: Live count of bad cases owned by the workspace after this report, as a decimal integer in a string because HTTP header values are strings.

201.description: A new bad case was created inside the workspace quota
